verdict.rationale: The Minnesota Secretary of State is a government business and lien filing registry. Its records are held by the state by statute, so a user-selectable storage region or residency option is a category error for this kind of product, not a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence suggests any storage-location choice is offered, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
